description: Manual Emulator Suite cases for firebase/database.rules.json

cases.name: owner isolation
cases.expect: owner A can read devices/A but not devices/B or telemetry/B

cases.name: device isolation
cases.expect: device A token can write telemetry/A only; device B and owner paths denied

cases.name: inactive and old version
cases.expect: writes denied when backend/deviceAccess active=false or token credentialVersion differs

cases.name: malformed payload
cases.expect: missing timestamp/values, unknown parameter, invalid status, non-number value denied

cases.name: partial writes and deletes
cases.expect: partial latest/history writes and deletes denied by .validate and .write

note: This manifest is a test contract, not a Firebase CLI deployment config. Run cases against the Firebase Emulator Suite after supplying auth/database emulator setup.
